# Tender Response -- Dnro 58/02.08.01/2026

Visakoivu Oy responds to Vuorikylan kunta's invitation to tender as follows.

## Eligibility

Visakoivu holds sahkourakointioikeudet luokka S1, which satisfies the class S2 minimum required under Section 3.1.

## Service levels

Proposed SLA: 4-hour response for emergency faults, 24-hour response for urgent faults, completion within 5 working days for routine work.

## Environmental management

During the works, environmental management arrangements include controlled waste handling, minimised disruption around occupied school and day-care buildings, and compliance with applicable environmental requirements.

## HVAC maintenance agreement

The proposed agreement covers scheduled inspection, filter and component replacement, and seasonal performance checks across the properties within scope.

## Commercial terms

Limitation of liability: capped per claim at the contract value. Price indexation: proposed annually against the relevant cost index.

## Submission

The tender will be submitted in the required format. Pricing is quoted per the invitation's pricing conventions.

## Annex A

Proposed maintenance visit schedule: regular scheduled visits across the year, adjusted by property type. Waste arising from the works is handled and sorted in accordance with standard practice.
